svg.metadata: {"story":"Isaiah","act":4,"chapter":"Ch.4 · Immanuel Sign","scene":"A","layer":"foreground","artDirection":"To faithless Ahaz the prophet gives a sign: the young woman is with child and shall call his name Immanuel — God with us.
